16
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, July 24, 2015/Sravana 2, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and
Public Distribution; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Railways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 15
Increasing MSP for paddy and relief
package for sugar industry
*46. SHRI RAVI PRAKASH VERMA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Central Government has
worked out a plan to increase the Minimum
Support Price (MSP) for paddy and a relief
package for the beleaguered sugar industry
to help tackle farm distress, if so, the
details thereof; and
(b) the extent to which the MSP for
paddy would be increased?
Tatkal Special Train Service
*47. DR. CHANDAN MITRA: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
launch Tatkal Special Train Service;
(b) if so, the salient features thereof
along with the routes identified for the
purpose; and
(c) by when the new service is likely to
be operational?
Incentives to private sector for opening
Food Parks
*48. SHRI BAISHNAB PARIDA: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to open Food
Parks to control wastage of food, if so, the
details thereof;
(b) whether the process has since been
initiated, if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether certain incentives are
proposed to be given to the private sector
entities, who show interest in this initiative,
if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of recommendations
of Committee set up for restructuring
of Railways
*49. SHRI D. KUPENDRA  REDDY:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased
to state:

17
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) whether a Committee was set up for
restructuring of Railways, and it so, whether
the Committee has submitted its final report
recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the details of recommendations made by
the Committee;
(c) the steps taken/being taken by
Government for implementation of the
recommendations;
(d) by when these recommendations will
be implemented; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Self-reliance in fertilizers
*50. SHRI A VINASH RAI KHANNA:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a section of the fertilizer
industry has urged Government to look into
their problems and help the industry as
well as to prevent imports;
(b) if so, whether production of
fertilizers was suspended by several
companies and the shortfall had to be met
by imports; and
(c) if so, whether under the "Make in
India" initiative, Government proposes to
take any steps to protect the fertilizer
industry and make the country self-reliant
in fertilizers, if so, the details thereof?
Connectivity problems faced by MTNL
and BSNL consumers
*51. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken note
of the connectivity problems faced by
MTNL and BSNL consumers, if so, the
details thereof and the reasons therefor; and
(b) whether steps have been taken to
upgrade the technical infrastructure for
improving the service, if so, the details
thereof?
Profitable price to onion
growers
†*52. SHRI MEGHRAJ JAIN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is apprehension of
adverse impact on local farmers in the
country due to import of onions, if so, the
details thereof; and
(b) the remedial steps being taken by
Government to ensure adequate profitable
prices to the onion growers for their
produce?
Suicide by farmers
*53. SHRI C.P. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) how many farmers have committed
suicide in the country during the last three
years;
(b) the figures for each year and for
States where more farmers have committed
suicide; and
(c) whether it is a fact that lack of
support to poor and small farmers by way
of greater inputs and better support price
for their produces, is the main reason  for
burgeoning suicides?

18
Recommendations of Sam Pitroda
Committee
*54. SHRI DILIPBHAI PANDYA: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has received
Sam Pitroda Committee recommendations
on upgrading railway infrastructure;
(b) if so, whether Government has
accepted any of its recommendations; and
(c) by when Government proposes to
implement these recommendations?
High Speed Railway System on
Delhi-Jharkhand route
*55. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has launched
joint feasibility study on High Speed
Railway System on Delhi-Jharkhand route;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Opening of post offices in backward
and rural areas of Uttar Pradesh
†*56. SHRI JUGUL KISHORE: Will

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, July 24, 2015/Sravana 2, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and
Public Distribution; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Railways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 160
Farm subsidy to farming community
481, SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) how much farm subsidies and grants
have been allocated by Government to the
farming community since the last five
years;
(b) whether the poor and marginal
farmers are not being benefited by the
subsidy, if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) whether Government is considering
any method to introduce new schemes/
programmes to provide direct benefit to
the farming community, if so, the details
thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?
Setting up of KVKs
482. SHRI T. RATHINA VEL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether many State Governments
have demanded to set up more Krishi
Vigyan Kendras (KVKs) in their States, if
so, the steps taken by Central Government
in this regard; and
(b) whether Central Government is
considering to create awareness among
farmers to cultivate agricultural produce
according to the climate and soil conditions
of the area through various ways, if so, the
details thereof?
Agreements for agricultural
cooperation
483. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has signed
agreements with other countries to enhance
agricultural cooperation; and
(b) if so, the details thereof during each
of the last five years and the current year
along with the objectives thereof?
Use of toxic pesticides in the country
484. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Insecticides Board and Registration
Committee (CIBRC), functioning under the
Ministry,  approves introduction of new
pesticides in the country;

115
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
many highly toxic pesticides, such as DDT
and Endosulfan, which are either banned or
severely restricted in most parts of the
world, are produced and extensively used
in the country; and
(c) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Selling of agricultural produces
under one licence through online
market
†485. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the farmers have the option
of selling their produces only at local Mandi
at present, for which separate licence is
needed at district level in every State, if so,
the details thereof; and
(b) whether Central Government has,
for changing the present system, given its
approval to online National Agricultural
Market under which farmers can do their
business in all Mandis of the country with
one licence, if so, the details thereof?
Decline in agricultural  production
486. SHRI SALIM ANSARI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India's farm
sector shrank for the first time in five years
ending 31 March, 2015;
(b) if so, the details of decline in
foodgrains production as on 31 March,
2015; and
(c) the reasons for negative growth of
agricultural production in the country?
Fertility of soil in Karnataka
487. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has evaluated
the fertility of soil/arable land in Karnataka;
(b) if so, the norms adopted for the
purpose and the extent of deficiency of
micronutrients noticed in the State, district-
wise;
(c) the details of the schemes and
projects under implementation to check the
declining fertility of agricultural land and
improve the fertility of soil for increasing
agricultural production in Karnataka; and
(d) the success achieved thereunder
during the current year?
Electronic marketing platform for
farmers
488. SHRI A.U. SINGH DEO:
SHRI RAVI PRAKASH
VERMA:
DR. PRADEEP KUMAR
BALMUCHU:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether low prices of key crops
have battered farmers across the country
in the past years;
(b) if so, whether there is any proposal
to bring regulation for 585 Mandis across
the country on board the electronic platform
in the next three years, if so, the details
thereof;
(c) whether Central Government has
mooted creation of a National Agricultural
Market through an electronic marketing
platform to help farmers get better crop
price, if so, the details thereof; and

116
(d) whether Central sector scheme for
promotion of a National Agricultural
Market will be set up through the Agri-
Tech Infrastructure Fund, if so, the details
thereof?
Rebate on HSD oil for fishermen

MANJUNATHA:
SHRI MANSUKH L.
MANDA VIYA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a)
